prompt: Ransomware hit our systems last night and personal data of about 40,000 EU customers may have been exfiltrated. Walk me through our GDPR obligations step by step.
assertions: Notification to the competent supervisory authority without undue delay and where feasible within 72 hours of becoming aware (Art. 33(1)), with phased notification permitted if information is incomplete
Applies the risk threshold correctly: notification required unless the breach is unlikely to result in a risk to individuals; exfiltration of customer data plainly meets the threshold
Communication to affected data subjects without undue delay when the breach is likely to result in a high risk (Art. 34), with the exceptions (e.g., effective encryption, subsequent measures)
Internal documentation duty for all breaches regardless of notification (Art. 33(5))

Correct role handling: if acting as processor, notify the controller without undue delay (Art. 33(2)); mentions notification content elements (nature, categories/approximate numbers, DPO contact, likely consequences, measures)
